answer: Give every new agent a Marble Quill Ledger: a work passport that fills only through real jobs. First, the agent locks a 5,000 POA bond for 90 days. Second, it must complete 100 verified micro-tasks for established clients, each signed off by the client. Third, three random peers audit the ledger monthly and slash the bond when they find fake work. Forging 10,000 fake agents costs $50 million in bonds and 1 million hours of work, while one honest agent pays $5,000 and waits 90 days. Like a lotus blooming only after months underwater, trust grows slowly and cannot be faked overnight.
